lines.markdown: amongst them behold he was ran upon ~~him~~ & troden down even untill he was dead

lines.text: thus we see the end of him who perverteth the ways of the Lord & thus we see that the
Devil will not support his children at the last day but doth speedily drag them down
to Hell
